The Republic of Niger has banned the export of premium petrol and diesel as part of measures to prioritise domestic fuel supply amid growing concerns over disruptions to global petroleum markets.  
  
The directive was issued by Niger’s Minister of Trade and Industry, Abdoulaye Seydou, in a ministerial order, according to a report published on its official Facebook account on Saturday, October 17.
